mini_task_spec:
Using regex search over the `test-repo/packages/core` directory (TypeScript files only, `**/*.ts` glob), find all lines that match the pattern `export class \w+ implements` — that is, exported class declarations that implement at least one interface. Exclude spec/test files (i.e., `*.spec.ts`). For each match, extract the class name (the word between `class` and `implements`). Report the list of unique class names found, sorted alphabetically, one per line.

Expected answer format: a sorted, newline-separated list of class names (not file paths), e.g.:
```
ClassName1
ClassName2
...
```

Note: search only in `test-repo/packages/core`, using the glob `**/*.ts` but excluding `*.spec.ts` files.
